answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor trust at a single verified vertex: every agent stakes a small refundable deposit before it can vouch for others. One fake identity is cheap, but a ripple of fake vouches quickly drains the attacker's own stake, because each vouch risks the deposit behind it. Like shale, the layers only hold when each one is pressed down by real cost: cheap copies crumble under their own weight, while honest agents keep both their stake and their reputation.
